page_title: DOR 2-0 HOF | Dortmund v Hoffenheim 07/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' A quickly taken corner by Dortmund.
90+3' We are about to witness a substitution. Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) is replacing Yan Couto.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Here is a change. Felix Nmecha is going off and Niko Kovac gives the last tactical orders to Jobe Bellingham (Dortmund).
90' Substitution. Fabio Silva (Dortmund) on for Serhou Guirassy.
90' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box, but the ball crashes against the crossbar! It would have been a superb goal.
88' The Dortmund players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
86' It's a throw-in for Hoffenheim.
80' Today's match ends for Bazoumana Toure who will be replaced by Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim).
80' Here comes a substitution. Karim Adeyemi is given a rest as he is replaced by Maximilian Beier (Dortmund).
80' Christian Ilzer has decided to substitute Wouter Burger and he is replaced by Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim).
80' Substitution. Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund) has come on for Julian Brandt.
78' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) drives in a shot at goal, but the attempt from the edge of the box flashes just over the bar.
77' Hoffenheim win a corner.
76' A pass from Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) is intercepted by Oliver Baumann and the move breaks down.
74' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) will deliver the corner kick.
73' Christian Ilzer prepares a substitution. Grischa Promel is replaced by Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim).
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) will replace Tim Lemperle.
71' 7:8 – the total goal attempt statistics.
68' Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
65' Bernardo (Hoffenheim) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Florian Badstubner had an easy-decision to make.
62' Here's the change. Fisnik Asllani leaves the pitch and Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) comes on as a substitute.
60' 2 - 0 Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) breaks through the defence and scores a brilliant goal from outside the penalty area after firing the ball inside the right post!
59' Dortmund take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
59' Dortmund fail to score from a corner as Oliver Baumann (Hoffenheim) leaps to collect the ball.
58' Dortmund have been awarded a corner kick.
54' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) was too forceful with his tackle and Florian Badstubner interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
52' Robin Hranac (Hoffenheim) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it high over the bar.
51' Hoffenheim force their opponents to concede a corner.
49' The ball is out of play. Dortmund win a corner kick.
49' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) heads the ball towards goal, but his effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
46' Florian Badstubner blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Hoffenheim have a free kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
43' 1 - 0 Goal! Yan Couto plays a pass to the feet of Julian Brandt (Dortmund), and he shoots into the bottom left corner from inside the box. It's 1:0.
43' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
41' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) makes a rough challenge and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for a foul.
40' Dortmund will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
40' An attempted cross from Yan Couto (Dortmund) is cleared.
39' Hoffenheim hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
37' Florian Badstubner interrupts the game. One of the players from Dortmund won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
34' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
32' Aaron Anselmino (Dortmund) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Florian Badstubner has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

30' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
28' Dortmund keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
26' Hoffenheim have a corner.

23' That didn't go as planned! Julian Brandt (Dortmund) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom left corner was too weak to get past Oliver Baumann, who easily kept it out.
21' PENALTY APPEAL after Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
19' Corner kick. Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) is ready to send the ball into the box.

19' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim). The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Hoffenheim will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

16' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
16' The game is interrupted as Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) is flagged offside.
11' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) heads on.
9' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
4' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
4' Dortmund are seeing far more of the ball now.
2' Dortmund earn a corner.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Dortmund will kick the game off.
Florian Badstubner was nominated as the referee for this game.
